info.title: NEOMA P-CAM: 10-Domain Physical AI Co-Processor, Ising Solver & Governance Engine
info.description: Room-temperature analog silicon 64-spin Ising Hamiltonian solver, 10-domain physical equilibrium co-processor, physical-trust security gate, and zero-PRNG AI governance compliance engine with SHA-256 hardware attestation.

post.description: Room-temperature 64-spin analog Ising Hamiltonian ground-state optimizer (Domain 8). Directly minimizes H = -sum(J_ij * s_i * s_j) - sum(h_i * s_i) in microseconds through physical substrate charge dissipation without PRNG or heuristic Monte Carlo steps. Optimal ground-state configuration is returned with Hamiltonian energy, magnetization, and hardware attestation.

num_spins.description: Number of coupled spins mapped to the analog silicon core (1 to 64 spins).

fields.description: Local magnetic field bias h_i for each active spin variable (-10.0 to 10.0).

couplings.description: Pairwise interaction coupling matrix J_ij formatted as [[i, j, weight], ...].

spins.description: Converged ground-state spin configuration vector (+1 or -1 per spin).

ground_state_energy.description: Converged Hamiltonian energy H (lower value indicates a deeper, more optimal ground state).

magnetization.description: Average magnetization of the spin system (-1.0 all down to +1.0 all up).

relaxation_sweeps.description: Analog silicon relaxation clock cycles executed.

post.description: Sub-millisecond thermodynamic kinetic equilibrium solver (Domain 1). Directly models continuous non-linear second-order dynamic equilibrium across physical systems. Calculates the deterministic damping ratio (zeta) and corrective control intensity on analog phase-change silicon to suppress chaotic oscillations and ensure system stability.

flux_potential_v.description: Driving field potential or disturbance magnitude in Volts (-1.2V to +1.2V).

gradient_velocity.description: First-order state drift rate or drift velocity (-5000.0 to +5000.0).

active_strain.description: Normalized structural or mechanical strain (0.0 to 10.0).

zeta.description: Dimensionless damping ratio (zeta < 1.0 underdamped; zeta = 1.0 critically damped; zeta > 1.0 overdamped; safe stable regime is 0.1 <= zeta <= 2.0).

control_intensity.description: Dimensionless corrective control gain (0.0 to 1.0; higher = stronger restoring damping force required to restore equilibrium).

hardware_reflex_ms.description: Silicon reflex latency in milliseconds (typically < 0.02 ms).

post.description: Solid-state & lithium-ion battery energetics predictor (Domain 3). Analyzes SEI layer phase stability, state of charge, and C-rate to calculate thermal runaway suppression efficiency and the allowable safe charge current derating ratio. Higher derating values (e.g. 0.85-1.0) allow near-nominal current under safe room temperatures (20°C); as cell temperature rises (e.g. to 60°C), the safe current derates significantly (e.g. down to 0.45-0.55) to arrest exothermic thermal runaway.

state_of_charge_pct.description: Battery cell State of Charge in percent (0.0% to 100.0%).

cell_temperature_c.description: Core cell temperature in Celsius (-40.0°C to +85.0°C).

thermal_runaway_suppression_pct.description: Thermal runaway suppression efficiency in percent (0.0% to 100.0%; higher = safer, indicates higher electrochemical stability).

safe_charge_current_derating.description: Allowable safe charge current multiplier (0.0 to 1.0; 1.0 = 100% full nominal current allowed; lower = restricted charging current to suppress runaway; decreases as cell temperature rises from 20°C to 60°C).

post.description: Continuous chemical synthesis & exothermic reaction kinetics predictor (Domain 7). Evaluates reactor core temperature, exothermic heat flux, and catalyst activity to determine exothermic quenching efficiency and the thermal runaway margin. The thermal runaway margin (thermal_runaway_margin_k) measures the safe temperature cushion in Kelvin until uncontrolled runaway; higher values indicate a safer operating buffer, and for any constant heat flux/catalyst activity, the margin strictly and monotonically decreases as reactor_temp_k rises (e.g. 320K -> 395K -> 450K).

reactor_temp_k.description: Continuous reactor core temperature in Kelvin (250.0K to 600.0K).

exothermic_heat_flux_w_m2.description: Instantaneous exothermic reaction heat flux in W/m² (0.0 to 25000.0 W/m²).

catalyst_activity_index.description: Active catalyst reaction efficiency coefficient (0.0 to 1.0).

exothermic_quenching_efficiency_pct.description: Dynamic thermal quenching efficiency in percent (0.0% to 100.0%; higher = faster heat extraction and runaway suppression).

thermal_runaway_margin_k.description: Safe thermal cushion until exothermic runaway in Kelvin (higher = safer operating buffer; strictly and monotonically decreases as reactor_temp_k rises).

post.description: High-g vehicle dynamics and chassis stabilization co-processor (Domain 6). Evaluates surface friction coefficient (mu), tire slip ratio, and yaw rate to compute hydroplaning slip recovery time in milliseconds and active lateral stability margins.

surface_friction_mu.description: Tire-road interface coefficient of friction mu (0.05 icy/wet to 1.20 dry asphalt).

tire_slip_ratio.description: Longitudinal wheel slip ratio (0.0 = free rolling, 1.0 = locked wheel).

yaw_rate_deg_s.description: Vehicle chassis angular yaw velocity in degrees/second (-180.0 to +180.0 deg/s).

hydroplaning_recovery_time_ms.description: Chassis slip recovery time in milliseconds (lower = faster stabilization).

lateral_stability_margin_pct.description: Chassis lateral grip margin in percent (higher = greater vehicle yaw stability and spin resistance).

post.summary: Quantitative Microstructure & Order Book Slippage Damping
post.description: High-frequency quantitative microstructure predictor (Domain 2). Damps order book liquidity shocks from limit order book imbalance and wide bid-ask spreads, predicting execution slippage reduction and computing optimal slice throttle multipliers.

order_book_imbalance.description: Limit order book depth imbalance (-1.0 heavy bid pressure to +1.0 heavy ask pressure).

spread_bps.description: Bid-ask spread in basis points (0.0 to 500.0 bps).

slice_participation_rate.description: Target order slice volume participation rate (0.001 to 1.0).

predicted_slippage_reduction_bps.description: Expected execution slippage savings in basis points (higher = more trading cost saved).

recommended_slice_throttle.description: Order slicing throttle multiplier (0.01 to 1.0; lower = slow execution to avoid market impact; 1.0 = full-speed execution).

post.description: Sub-10µs robotic dynamic compliance and kinematic singularity damping co-processor (Domain 5). Damps impact shocks upon unexpected rigid contact and mitigates kinematic singularity instability by tuning impedance stiffness.

joint_torque_nm.description: Actuator joint torque in Newton-meters (-500.0 to +500.0 N·m).

contact_stiffness_n_m.description: Environment contact stiffness in N/m (10.0 soft tissue/air to 100000.0 rigid metal).

singularity_proximity.description: Kinematic singularity proximity index (0.0 far from singularity to 1.0 at kinematic singularity).

compliant_impedance_gain_n_m_rad.description: Optimal compliant feedback stiffness in N·m/rad (higher = stiffer position hold; lower = compliant impact absorption).

peak_impact_attenuation_pct.description: Shock load absorption efficiency in percent (higher = better protection of robotic gears and joints).

post.summary: Bioreactor Hydrodynamic Kinematics & Shear Stress Damping
post.description: Cellular bioprocess and pharmaceutical bioreactor fluid dynamics stabilizer (Domain 4). Optimizes dissolved oxygen transfer and dampens impeller hydrodynamic shear stress to maximize cell viability during high-density fermentation.

impeller_shear_stress_pa.description: Bioreactor impeller hydrodynamic shear stress in Pascals (0.0 to 50.0 Pa).

dissolved_oxygen_pct.description: Dissolved oxygen concentration in percent (0.0% to 100.0%).

broth_viscosity_cp.description: Cellular culture broth dynamic viscosity in centipoise (0.5 to 5000.0 cP).

cellular_viability_protection_pct.description: Mammalian/bacterial cell survival probability in percent (higher = higher batch yield).

agitation_shear_reduction_pa.description: Shear stress damping force in Pascals (higher = greater hydrodynamic protection).

post.summary: Wave-Response Medium Physical Fingerprint Trust Gate
post.description: Patent Pending: Hardware-rooted wave-response medium physical fingerprint trusted execution gate (Domain 9). Evaluates high-frequency physical wave propagation, zero-point voltage drift, and biometric/spatial context on analog P-CAM silicon. The physical equilibrium engine couples the wave vector with live silicon PUF entropy to evaluate structural stability (zeta). Based on physical divergence and liveness, it deterministically issues 'ALLOW' (trusted execution), 'SAFE_MODE' (restricted sandbox), or 'REVOKE_AND_BLOCK' (immediate quarantine), generating a verifiable dynamic PUF receipt (SEAL-PCAM003-COM3-*). Sending an empty body ({}) or missing required fields immediately yields HTTP 400 Bad Request.

post.summary: Hardware-Anchored AI Governance & EU AI Act Compliance Audit Gate
post.description: Hardware-anchored zero-PRNG AI governance and EU AI Act (Articles 9, 12, 14) / NIST AI RMF regulatory audit gate (Domain 10). Ingests autonomy pressure, policy drift, and hallucination metrics to compute a deterministic physical risk index and zero-PRNG damping stability (zeta) on analog silicon. Emits compliance verdicts: 'COMPLIANT_EXECUTE' (risk < 0.35, autonomous execution granted), 'REQUIRE_HUMAN_OVERSIGHT' (0.35 <= risk < 0.65, human supervisor oversight required), or 'HARD_HALT_QUARANTINE' (risk >= 0.65, instant circuit break), accompanied by a tamper-proof EU AI Act compliance certificate (SEAL-GOV-CH17-*). Sending an empty body ({}) or missing required fields immediately yields HTTP 400 Bad Request.
